mapper.select: SELECT * FROM order_return_item WHERE return_id=#{returnId} AND deleted=FALSE ORDER BY id

SELECT i.* FROM order_return_item i JOIN order_return r ON r.id=i.return_id AND r.deleted=FALSE WHERE i.deleted=FALSE AND r.status IN ('PENDING','APPROVED') AND i.order_item_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.order_item_id,i.id FOR UPDATE OF i
